title: Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Irish-inspired lamb stew made with tender lamb, roasted vegetables, and a rich broth. Serve with a side of steamed rice for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, brown the lamb on all sides over medium-high heat.
Add the carrots, potatoes, onion, and garlic to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and chicken broth to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
